proof.mixed_definition: Mean of 2H, 4H+, 6H+ RichEpsilon transition laws, epsilon=0.025; fraction fitted.

regression_policy: Predeclared one projected counting-noise unit for worsening shape and integrated-count error in each original protected ROI, anchored to the original background-stage fit. Background sensitivity excluded. No improvement-bin credit, ROI-size averaging, or sequential tolerance resets. Operational budget, not a confidence interval. Exact no-worse results also retained.

continuous_origin_transport_probe.status: Exact conditional origin mapping verified on continuous local-m0 physical functions; no interpolation or source quadrature reduction.
continuous_origin_transport_probe.scope: Finite matched incident states; current packets have unbounded sample support and zero external-path attenuation. Reference queries restricted to common in-panel interior for this proof; future reuse must include an off-panel halo.
continuous_origin_transport_probe.source_law: Position conditional on divergence must preserve rho=[-0.1477984535,+0.3873100736] and the spherical exponential-map angular coordinates.
continuous_origin_transport_probe.adoption: A global translation blur is not adopted. Exact coordinate reuse alone does not reduce physical function evaluations. Any cached representation or reduced directional quadrature needs separate convergence and benchmark before default use.

angular_interpolation_proof.method: On each grid interval, h^2 sup|F second derivative|/(8 inf F); positive transfer sums inherit the global relative bound.
angular_interpolation_proof.scope: Angular density interpolation only. Does not certify source, fold or detector quadrature.

normalization_and_stacking.mixture_location: Average transition laws before chain propagation. Phase populations are summed as intensities.
normalization_and_stacking.termination_atom_count: Every termination retains 3N atoms; no missing/extra iodine.
